Full realm enumeration/lifecycle, worker-to-main attachment, debugger pause/resume, enabled open/close/URL/wait lifecycle, coverage, CLI/session sampling coexistence, tamper-resistant primordials, every shutdown schedule, all-platform/Release/ASAN and full Bun-suite proof remain incomplete.
